posts.name: MindWanderer
posts.cooked: Since she enters the Fugue State as a result of seeing OblivAeon coming, that doesn't seem to be related to her unlock condition.  Might simply have to replicate a part of her backstory that happened before.  Parse and the Freedom Five vs. Miss Information is the most obvious, but she's fought a wide range of random baddies, including Progeny.  Another possibility is that it's just about one of her own mechanics--she's all about information, which is represented as cards in the game, so it might involve drawing or discarding lots of cards, hoarding them in your hand, or possibly even replicating a "fugue state" by playing with an empty hand for a certain amount of time.

posts.name: WalkingTarget
posts.cooked:
We know from the Letters Page that the Skinwalker Gloomweaver fight was the last major event to happen before the OblivAeon event proper began (like the very next issue published after its conclusion was the start of the OblivAeon stuff). Skinwalker Gloomweaver's first appearance was Tome of the Bizarre #34, which is the issue quoted on Parse's card "Updated Intel" (it's also the issue on a few of the Sentinels' cards where the art has them fighting Gloomy).

My thoughts (which I haven't tested yet) involve her, possibly with other characters present in those cards, so Nightmist, Argent Adept, and the Sentinels vs Skinwalker Gloomweaver (or possibly preceded by Agent of Gloom Spite - maybe even the challenge mode combination fight).
